# Counter vector: CLK is the input pin; Q is a 6-bit unsigned output.
CLK Q <set> <seq>
0 000000 1 1
1 000000 1 2
0 000000 1 3
1 000001 1 4
0 000001 1 5
1 000010 1 6
0 000010 1 7
1 000011 1 8
0 000011 1 9
1 000100 1 10
0 000100 1 11
1 000101 1 12
0 000101 1 13
1 000110 1 14
0 000110 1 15
1 000111 1 16
0 000111 1 17
1 001000 1 18
0 001000 1 19
